notes.title: Thanks for an Amazing Steam Next Fest & It's Time to Get Back to Development!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We've just wrapped up an amazing Steam Next Fest! A heartfelt thank you to everyone who played our demos, shared valuable feedback, and most importantly, believed in our projects by wishlisting our games during this busy and exciting week!

To all the new players who discovered us and joined us during the festival, we want to give a huge "Welcome!" on behalf of our team. As an independent studio, your interest and support are our greatest source of fuel and motivation. 

Now, It's Time to Get Back to Development!
We've gathered all the valuable feedback and notes we received from you during the festival. In the coming months, we'll be focusing all our energy on turning our games into the content-rich and polished final versions we envision. Your patience and support during this process are invaluable to us. 


Follow Our Journey on Our Shared Channels
We are a small team working on two different projects at the same time. That's why we share all news, behind-the-scenes content, and important announcements about our development journey on our shared social media channels. By following us, you can stay up-to-date on the progress of both our games. 

Thank you again for being with us on this exciting journey. We'll be back with more news and updates soon! 

Best,  

Bavsimus 
Zero Task

notes.title: Small Bugfix #1
notes.content:
A small but important bugfix for Co's garden:


Now hoe upgrade can be maxed out.
You can buy Cherry saplings properly.
You can sell Cherries properly.
Fixed a game breaking bug where if you don't have enough money for importation upgrade for new saplings, you could still click the buy button without unlocking a new sapling, therefore softlocking yourself.
Fixed a quality upgrade bug which was not upgrading the value of fruits even if you buy the upgrade.
Fixed some UI elements.
Fixed the House wall.
Fixed the launch problem on MacOS.
And minor optimization improvements.

notes.title: Demo Release & Big Update!
notes.content:
Shake it Co! Demo is Live!

We released the Shake it Co! Demo couple of days ago and we're so happy that you can now try it!


Who is Co?
Co is this chill dude. He usually waits... for anything to happen. Wanders around. He thinks about things (maybe, we're not sure). But most importantly, he loves his trees. He shakes his trees and gather fruits!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589386/4f771524ebaad304123b31909db7bf767b262b4f.png

Here's the first big update to the Demo:

🐞Bugfixes

 ⌨️ESC key will correctly close menu panels
 🍒Cherries can be sold correctly
 ⚙️Fixed UI elements in the Settings Menu
 🎮Fixed a bug that causes controllers to vibrate uncontrollably.
 💾Save and load system works correctly and now gives an heads up when you save the game
 🚀Remarkable amount of optimizations have been made and more on the way
 📖"How to Play" panel in the menu can now be closed properly
 🌐"Zero Task Star" bottom left in the menu is now properly redirects you to our website
 🌳Fixed a game breaking issue that messes up fruit drop rate, tree grow time and fruit count in a tree after loading your game
 🔊Fixed a sound bug which causes some sound levels doesn't change even though you change it.
 🪴Fixed a game breaking issue that prevents you buy new saplings even though you purchased enough importation upgrades after you load your game
 😱Fixed a game breaking bug which causes losing your save data if you quit the game

✨New Features / Changes✨

 ⏱️Base tree grow time 40 sec -> 35 sec
 💰Base importation upgrade cost 30 gold -> 25 gold
 ⏳The time interval to disappear for fruits that are not collected 30 sec -> 1 min
 ⏭️The beginning intro video is now skippable
 🪴You can now buy more than one sapling at one time
 🧘New Chill Mode: You can just click and hold and Co will shake the trees!
 🖱️New Clicker Mode: Turns the game into a true clicker.


And that's it for the first week of Demo Release! We are working on Shake it Co! Demo constantly and getting it ready to The Steam Next Fest June 2025!🚨Don't forget to give feedbacks to us using the usual channels below this text.

And don't forget to add the game to your wishlist!

We'll see you next time!

- Zero Task
